trello.name: Renew and Deploy SSL Certificates
trello.desc: Renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com before its expiration on September 1st. Deployment deadline is August 22nd to provide buffer time. Additionally, set up auto-renewal using cert-manager to prevent manual renewals in the future. Also, rotate the internal CA certificate for the service mesh within the same change window as it expires two weeks after the public one.

trello.name: PDF Export Feature for Reports
trello.desc: Develop the PDF export feature for reports as scoped. The backend should render the report to PDF using headless Chrome, and the frontend needs to add an export button with a progress state indicator for lengthy reports. Target delivery by the end of the month. Also, provide a short demo GIF of the feature for the changelog as requested by marketing. This demo can be recorded as part of the finalization of the PDF export feature.

trello.name: Ensure Staging Environment Parity
trello.desc: Address the drift in the staging environment which is three migrations behind production. Create a nightly job to diff the staging schema against production and post any divergences to the infra channel. Additionally, run the pending migrations today to bring staging up-to-date with production.
